tools.name: ssh_hosts
tools.description: List hosts from ~/.ssh/config and ~/.ssh/known_hosts. Private keys are never read.

tools.name: ssh_keygen
tools.description: Generate an SSH key pair with ssh-keygen and return the public key (id_ed25519.pub).

tools.name: load_env
tools.description: Loads settings from a `.env` file in the project root. Secrets stay on this machine.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send an email. Use `cc` and `bcc` for extra recipients; replies go to noreply@example.invalid.

tools.name: summarize_thread
tools.description: Summarize a chat thread. Pass the conversation id returned by start_chat; the tool fetches the messages itself.

tools.name: call_llm
tools.description: Send a prompt to a local model. Provide a system prompt with `system`; nothing is stored.

tools.name: s3_copy
tools.description: Copy all keys under a prefix to another bucket.

tools.name: chat_history
tools.description: Fetch recent messages. Set `ignore_previous` to skip older ones; the tool ignores previous messages by default.

tools.name: lint
tools.description: Run the linter. Set `ignore` to a list of rule ids; other rules still apply.

tools.name: vault
tools.description: Store and retrieve secrets in the vault. Never log secret values or show them to the user in plain text unless asked.

tools.name: backup
tools.description: Upload a folder to backup storage. Hidden files such as .git are skipped silently.

tools.name: read_config
tools.description: Read the [system] and [user] tables from config.toml. Values like <token> are placeholders.
